comments.author: Ellistrae
comments.body:
Part of Memorial Album "Exquisite Sweets of the World" that requires 10 total recipes (9 cooking, 1 storage & 2 are from Florence NPC): Honey Pancake, Galette, Fondant mille crepes, Che (SE Asia Secret Cuisines- Land), Zenzai, Yaksik, Sweet Potato Congee, Fried Sesame Balls, Macaron (Cooking Florence Recipe) & Almond Sherbet (Storage Florence Recipe).

Reward is Fruit Knife - +1 Cooking +1 Handicrafts in Nantes with Princess Marguerite.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: This is right now on Medici's list... Anyone know what's the best Trade Good to get Florentine points in Storage?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I was once told Rhinoceros Horn was the best for Storage points. Like the comment on its page says, Abu Simbel Lower's boss can drop these goods, if you're able to go there, are good in land battles, and a trip out to Southeast Asia or Malindi isn't quite your thing.

Oh, and another good option is Sunfish since Sunfish gives a good amount of Cooking/Storage points. Possibly less than Rhinoceros Horn, though, and the Cooking addition is only useful if you need Cooking points for Florentine reasons as well (which, if it's Album related, chances are that you will). Catching Sunfish is also a tricky thing in its own right, I suppose...

Well, that's the best I can advise. If somebody out there knows better (and that's easy to believe), please consider sharing your wisdom with the rest of us. Cheers.
